audited_product_bundle.query: Under contemporary Swiss case law, when is a contractual non-compete clause (Konkurrenzklausel / clause de non-concurrence) valid and enforceable against a former employee?
query_variants: non-compete clause Swiss Federal Supreme Court requirements

answer.prose: Under contemporary Swiss case law a contractual non-compete clause (Konkurrenzklausel / clause de non-concurrence) is valid and enforceable against a former employee only if it is limited in time, in space and as to content, is justified by a protectable interest of the employer, and remains proportionate to the employee's actual activity, a two-year duration being in principle admissible where trade secrets are at stake [CH-2020-FR-001]; the assessment is function-specific rather than categorical, so a clause that covers all employees regardless of the actual competitive risk violates the principle of proportionality and is unenforceable, the decisive factors being the concrete function and access rights to customer data [CH-2019-DE-014], and equally the clause cannot be opposed to an employee who had no access to confidential information, the exception of absence of real competition prevailing over the clause and the employer bearing the burden of proving a concrete risk [CH-2022-IT-007]. Two further requirements/limits follow from the sources: if the employer waives the compensation for restraint (Karenzentschädigung) during the notice period, the entire clause becomes unenforceable and subsequent cure is excluded, even where the other conditions are met [CH-2021-DE-042], and no non-compete may be imposed in an apprenticeship relationship, since the apprentice's interest in earning a livelihood outweighs the training company's economic interest [CH-2018-DE-031]; note that the older, more permissive line under which it sufficed that the employer's interest was protectable without a strict proportionality review of the content has been abandoned by recent case law and survives only in decisions still being cited [CH-2016-FR-088], so any proposition beyond these retrieved sources (e.g., precise thresholds for geographic scope or the quantum of the Karenzentschädigung) must be treated as uncertain.
